explanation: Background statement for erdosproblems.com/712, which speaks of 'this limit': for all r, k the normalised extremal numbers ex_r(n, K_k^r)/C(n,r) converge to some π ∈ [0,1]. This is the standard Katona–Nemetz–Simonovits averaging result (the ratio is eventually non-increasing in n); degenerate parameter choices also give convergent sequences. The docstring correctly notes that existence does not determine the value. Correct.
